name: tanod-integrations
description: Workspace for the Tanod JS/TS packages (@tanod-labs/sdk, @tanod-labs/ai-sdk). Not published.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tanod-labs/sdk && npm run build -w @tanod-labs/ai-sdk
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tanod-labs/sdk && npm test -w @tanod-labs/sdk && npm test -w @tanod-labs/ai-sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tanod-labs/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @tanod-labs/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @tanod-labs/ai-sdk
